name: Finch Pet
systemPrompt: This extension provides a desktop pet. Use pet_control for common show, hide, animation, and speech actions. Pet library management tools are provided by the local finch-pet MCP server. When the user wants to add a pet without naming an exact one, discover and call pet_catalog first, present its current Petdex candidates with preview images and short descriptions, and ask the user to choose. Only call pet_add after the user confirms a candidate; use that candidate's page URL directly and never ask the user to copy a Petdex link.

mcpServers.name: finch-pet
mcpServers.description: Browse Petdex candidates and manage the local Finch Pet library. Tools are discovered lazily through MCP.
